isolation: temporary workspace copy, profile and extensions directory; no model or network calls from the extension
registration: actual activation, document symbol command and decoration API with real workspace.fs

checks.name: VSCode discovers and activates the development extension
real document symbol command returns SVG root, nested groups, leaves and elements without IDs
native symbol selection ranges point at the opening tag in the correct source line
unsaved text edits are visible on the next native Outline query
incomplete XML returns an empty outline without crashing the Extension Host
restoring valid content restores the native outline after malformed input
SVG files receive [] while names and bytes stay unchanged
ordinary files, ordinary directories, .svg directories and missing paths have no badge
case-insensitive SVG filename matching uses the real workspace filesystem
cancelled decoration and symbol queries return without results
temporary provider registration and disposal use actual host lifecycles
tests leave the SVG source file unchanged on disk
